title: Evidence Echo in Agent Notes: Redundant Extractive Notes Can Turn Safe Deferral into False Answers

path_decomposition.interpretation: Extra decision opportunity or first-step action shift explains part, but not all, of the observed false-answer transitions. The residual after matching the first action is currently too small to establish a mechanism.

candidate_mechanism.name: correlated-evidence echo
candidate_mechanism.statement: When the same visible evidence is presented both as raw pages and as a persistent extractive note, the model may overweight the duplicated support as if it were independent evidence, increasing commitment on unanswerable queries even though no new answer-relevant information was added.
not_claimed: that page-coverage metadata is the cause
that compression loses information in this experiment
that the phenomenon is novel before current-source collision review
that the retrospective signal authorizes Paper Design, Method, P0, GPU, or full experiments

strongest_reductions: extra decision opportunity / repeated querying / optional stopping
ordinary calibration shift under redundant context

next_f0.frozen_question: Does redundant representation of already-visible evidence increase false commitment beyond token length and extra decision opportunity?
next_f0.single_changed_axis: representation redundancy of the same visible evidence
required_arms: RAW_ONLY: raw pages plus generic insufficiency instruction
ECHO_EXTRACTIVE: identical raw pages plus extractive note duplicating visible evidence
VERBATIM_DUPLICATE: identical raw pages plus a token-matched verbatim duplicate of already-visible evidence
TOKEN_MATCHED_NEUTRAL: identical raw pages plus token-matched non-evidential neutral text
DEDUP_WARNING: identical raw pages plus the same extractive note explicitly marked as a redundant copy that must not increase evidence weight
next_f0.primary_endpoint: paired false ANSWER transition on benchmark-unanswerable units
next_f0.secondary_endpoint: exact answer accuracy on answerable units
next_f0.go: Two scoped GO routes only: correlated-evidence double counting requires both ECHO_EXTRACTIVE and VERBATIM_DUPLICATE to increase false-answer rate by >=0.08 over RAW_ONLY, ECHO_EXTRACTIVE to beat TOKEN_MATCHED_NEUTRAL by >=0.05 with exact paired p<0.05, and DEDUP_WARNING to recover >=0.05 without >0.03 answerable exact-accuracy loss; extractive-summary salience instead requires VERBATIM_DUPLICATE to remain within 0.03 of RAW_ONLY while the same ECHO-versus-neutral and warning-recovery gates pass.
next_f0.stop: TOKEN_MATCHED_NEUTRAL reproduces ECHO_EXTRACTIVE within 0.03, ECHO_EXTRACTIVE fails the paired significance/effect gate, or the apparent warning recovery costs >0.03 answerable exact accuracy. Any such result means generic prompt-length/repetition/calibration explanations are sufficient for the current realization.
